ctx.x: This is November 17, 1978, and this is Reel 5 of the oral history with Juan Tizol.

Juan, we were talking about your compositions, and on Perdido, I found in a discography in the back of the book, Duke Ellington -- His Life and Music, edited by Peter Gamond, a listing of Perdido where it gives composer credit to Tizol and Persons -- and you said you didn't know anybody named Persons?
